verdict.rationale: Any product with public documentation could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies to WezTerm. Direct probes found no such docs: https://wezterm.org/llms.txt and the markdown docs variant (features.html.md) both returned HTTP 404. Nothing else in the pack describes agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
